mapper.sql: id, batch_id, memory_id, source_execution_id, step, status, schema_version, snapshot_json, version, claimed_at, resolved_at, create_time, modify_time
mapper.insert: insert into ai_agent_interrupt_snapshot (batch_id, memory_id, source_execution_id, step, status, schema_version, snapshot_json, version, create_time, modify_time) values (#{batchId}, #{memoryId}, #{sourceExecutionId}, #{step}, #{status}, #{schemaVersion}, #{snapshotJson}, #{version}, #{createTime}, #{modifyTime})
mapper.select: select from ai_agent_interrupt_snapshot where memory_id = #{memoryId} and status = 'PENDING' order by id desc limit 1
mapper.update: update ai_agent_interrupt_snapshot set status = 'RESUMING', version = version + 1, claimed_at = #{now}, modify_time = #{now} where batch_id = #{batchId} and status = 'PENDING'
update ai_agent_interrupt_snapshot set status = 'COMPLETED', version = version + 1, resolved_at = #{now}, modify_time = #{now} where batch_id = #{batchId} and status <> 'COMPLETED'
update ai_agent_interrupt_snapshot set status = 'CANCELLED', version = version + 1, resolved_at = #{now}, modify_time = #{now} where batch_id = #{batchId} and status = 'PENDING'
